nodes.label: graphify skill (/graphify trigger)
nodes.rationale: When the user types /graphify, use the installed skill before doing anything else.

nodes.label: graphify query
nodes.rationale: Run before first grep/search/source read; returns a scoped subgraph much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep.

nodes.label: graphify update .
nodes.rationale: Keeps the graph current after code changes (AST-only, no API cost).

nodes.label: graph.json whole-file rebuild policy
nodes.rationale: graph.json is rewritten whole on every build, so large PR diffs are expected and should not be flagged as churn.

nodes.label: 액세스 키 커밋 금지
nodes.rationale: Access keys must never be committed.

nodes.label: 자격증명 미포함 원칙 (.env + .gitignore)
nodes.rationale: API keys and passwords are never committed; kept in .env excluded by .gitignore.

nodes.label: 실습 환경(VM) 한정 공격 실습 원칙
nodes.norm_label: 실습 환경(vm) 한정 공격 실습 원칙
nodes.rationale: Attack/vulnerability content was performed only in class lab VMs; scanning/attacking unauthorized targets is illegal.

nodes.label: 원리 → 실습 → 대응 방안 정리 구조
nodes.norm_label: 원리 → 실습 → 대응 방안 정리 구조
nodes.rationale: Each vulnerability is documented as principle, then lab practice in the lab VM, then remediation.
